title: Squash | Calm Joints
description: A short squash kit for between matches, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist.
sub: Squash puts real load on ankles, knees and wrists: hard lunges, fast turns, back-to-back matches. Here’s a short kit for between matches, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist if you’d like to talk through how you move.
